enums.name: ke_result_domain
enums.doc: The domains that own a range of result codes. A domain's own codes are written `KE_RESULT_CODE(KE_RESULT_DOMAIN_ <DOMAIN >, n)` in its header, with `n` from 1 up.

enums.name: ke_result
enums.doc: What a fallible call returns: `KE_OK`, or the code of the failure. The detail of a failure goes to the failing library's log, never into the code. A caller treats a code it does not know as `KE_RESULT_GENERAL`. Ignoring the result of a call is a compiler warning where the compiler supports it.

structs.name: ke_vec3
structs.doc: Three floats, x then y then z.

structs.name: ke_vec4
structs.doc: Four floats, x then y then z then w.

structs.name: ke_quat
structs.doc: A rotation; the four lanes are x, y, z, w.

structs.name: ke_transform
structs.doc: Spatial transform: where a thing is, how it is turned, and how big it is.

structs.name: ke_variant_table_entry
structs.doc: One authored key and its value. Whoever accepts the key sets `consumed`; the loader reports every entry left unclaimed.

fields.name: default_value
fields.doc: What the field holds when nothing authors it. KE_VARIANT_NULL means the header declared no default and zero stands.

fields.name: enum_names
fields.doc: The names a scene may write for an integer field, in value order; a name stands for its index. NULL leaves the field numeric.

fields.name: enum_count
fields.doc: Entries in `enum_names`.

structs.name: ke_component_params
structs.doc: What a component type is registered with.

fields.name: name
fields.doc: Unique component name.

fields.name: size
fields.doc: Bytes per entity; 0 registers a tag (no storage).

fields.name: alignment
fields.doc: A power of two for a sized component; ignored for a tag of size 0.

fields.name: fields
fields.doc: The type's field layout, normally its field table; must outlive the ecs. NULL registers the size alone.

fields.name: field_count
fields.doc: Entries in `fields`; 0 when `fields` is NULL.

structs.name: ke_ecs_segment
structs.doc: One archetype's slice of a query match: the matched entities, plus one column base pointer per query term in the order query_register received them, each aligned 1:1 with `entities`. A tag term's column is NULL. Pointers stay valid until the next structural change.

fields.name: entities
fields.doc: The entities this segment matched.

fields.name: columns
fields.doc: One base pointer per query term.

structs.name: ke_node_component
structs.doc: A component a spawned node starts with in place of its type's initial value.

fields.name: component
fields.doc: One of the components the type carries.

fields.name: data
fields.doc: The component's bytes, copied by the spawn.

fields.name: size
fields.doc: The component's registered size.

structs.name: ke_node_with
structs.doc: A component every node of a type carries beside its fields, and how it is born.

fields.name: name
fields.doc: The registered component's name.

fields.name: initial
fields.doc: The bytes each node starts with; none starts it zeroed.

fields.name: initial_size
fields.doc: The component's registered size, or 0 to start it zeroed.

structs.name: ke_action_ref
structs.doc: An input action named by a node's fields and resolved the first time a behaviour reads it. A scene writes its name; zeroed memory is a reference not yet resolved.

fields.name: name
fields.doc: The action's name in the input action maps.

fields.name: id
fields.doc: The action's id once resolved; meaningful only while resolved is true.

fields.name: resolved
fields.doc: Whether id holds the result of looking the name up.

structs.name: ke_node_type_desc
structs.doc: A node type: its name, its own fields, the components its nodes also carry, and its behaviours.

fields.name: name
fields.doc: The type's name; its nodes carry a tag registered as `node. <name >`.

fields.name: fields
fields.doc: The type's own fields, registered as a component; NULL for a type made only of the components it names in `with`.

fields.name: initial
fields.doc: The bytes copied into the fields of each node spawned; none starts them zeroed.

fields.name: initial_size
fields.doc: `fields->size`, or 0 to start them zeroed.

fields.name: with
fields.doc: Registered components every node of the type carries beside its fields, each with the value it is born with.

fields.name: ready
fields.doc: Runs once per node, in the PreUpdate after the node is created, before its first update.

fields.name: update
fields.doc: Runs every tick, in Update.

fields.name: fixed_update
fields.doc: Runs every fixed step, in FixedUpdate.

fields.name: events
fields.doc: The event types `on` handles.

fields.name: on
fields.doc: Runs in PostUpdate for each node and each event raised this tick of a type in `events`; the ctx's `event_type` says which.

fields.name: user_data
fields.doc: Forwarded to every behaviour.

slots.name: entity_create
slots.doc: Creates a fresh entity with no components. Structural; single-threaded.
slots.return_doc: KE_OK; KE_RESULT_INVALID_ARGUMENT when the backend refuses the call, its reason logged.

params.name: out_entity
params.doc: Receives the entity; the null entity on failure.

slots.name: entity_destroy
slots.doc: Destroys an entity and all its components; an entity that is not alive is left alone. Structural; single-threaded.
slots.return_doc: KE_OK; KE_RESULT_INVALID_ARGUMENT for the null entity or when the backend refuses the call, its reason logged.

slots.name: component_register
slots.doc: Registers a component type by name, or returns the existing id if already registered. A repeated name must describe the same size, alignment and layout as its first registration. With `fields` the layouts are compared field by field; without them, only the size and the alignment are compared.
slots.return_doc: KE_OK; KE_RESULT_INVALID_ARGUMENT when the params are missing, the alignment is not a power of two, or the type conflicts with the name's prior registration, what disagrees being logged; KE_RESULT_OUT_OF_MEMORY.

params.name: params
params.doc: The name, size, alignment and field table of the type.

params.name: out_cid
params.doc: Receives the component's id; KE_COMPONENT_INVALID on failure.

slots.name: component_lookup
slots.doc: Looks up a previously registered component by name.
slots.return_doc: false if no component of that name is registered.

params.name: name
params.doc: Component name to find.

params.name: out_meta
params.doc: Receives the component's id, size, and field metadata.

slots.name: component_add
slots.doc: Attaches a component to an entity: its storage is zeroed, then seeded with the defaults of the field table the component was registered with, on the first attach; an entity that already has the component keeps its storage unchanged. Structural; single-threaded.
slots.return_doc: KE_OK; KE_RESULT_INVALID_ARGUMENT for an entity that is not alive, the null entity or component, or when the backend refuses the call, its reason logged.

params.name: out_data
params.doc: Receives the storage, valid until the next structural change on this ecs; NULL for a tag, and on failure.

slots.name: component_remove
slots.doc: Detaches a component from an entity; an entity that is not alive is left alone. Structural; single-threaded.
slots.return_doc: KE_OK; KE_RESULT_INVALID_ARGUMENT for the null entity or component, or when the backend refuses the call, its reason logged.

slots.name: component_get
slots.doc: Returns an entity's component storage, or NULL if it doesn't have that component. The pointer is valid until the next structural change on this ecs.

slots.name: component_size
slots.doc: Byte size of a registered component's element; 0 for a tag or unknown cid.

slots.name: component_field_write
slots.doc: Writes value into component at the place field describes, converted to the field's type: an integer and a float convert to each other, a boolean to an integer, and a vector widens or narrows to the field's width; a string is cut to the field's size and stays NUL-terminated.
slots.return_doc: KE_OK; KE_RESULT_INVALID_ARGUMENT for a null argument, or for a value that does not convert to the field's type or a size the type cannot have, writing nothing.

params.name: component
params.doc: The component's memory.

params.name: field
params.doc: Where in the component, and of which type and size.

params.name: value
params.doc: The value to write.

slots.name: query_register
slots.doc: Registers a query over a component tuple (entities matching ALL cids).
slots.return_doc: KE_OK; KE_RESULT_INVALID_ARGUMENT for an empty tuple, one with more terms than the backend's queries hold, or one the backend refuses, its reason logged; KE_RESULT_OUT_OF_MEMORY.

params.name: cids
params.doc: Component tuple to match.

params.name: cid_count
params.doc: Number of components in the tuple.

params.name: out_query
params.doc: Receives the query; KE_QUERY_INVALID on failure.

slots.name: query_resolve
slots.doc: Resolves a query into archetype segments. MUST run single-threaded, before a parallel wave; afterwards the segments are plain memory touching no backend state.
slots.return_doc: KE_OK; KE_RESULT_INVALID_ARGUMENT for an unknown query, missing output arrays or a zero capacity, or when the backend refuses the call, its reason logged.

params.name: out_segments
params.doc: Receives the matched segments.

params.name: max_segments
params.doc: Capacity of out_segments.

params.name: out_columns
params.doc: Backing store of the segments' columns: segment i's columns are the cid_count entries starting at index i * cid_count, cid_count being the length of the tuple the query was registered with.

params.name: out_count
params.doc: Receives how many segments the query matches; above max_segments, out_segments holds only the first max_segments of them; zero on failure.

slots.name: entity_reserve
slots.doc: Reserves an entity id, callable concurrently from any wave thread — the one entity operation that is. The id is usable immediately as a reference; the entity itself appears in the world when component_add first runs for it, at the wave barrier. An implementation may not satisfy this by forwarding to entity_create, which is single-threaded.
slots.return_doc: KE_OK; KE_RESULT_OUT_OF_MEMORY when every id the implementation can reserve was handed out.

params.name: out_entity
params.doc: Receives the id; the null entity on failure.

slots.name: entity_materialize
slots.doc: Brings a reserved id into the world, so an entity that never receives a component still exists. Structural; single-threaded. A no-op for an id that is already alive or was never reserved.
slots.return_doc: KE_OK; KE_RESULT_INVALID_ARGUMENT for the null entity or when the backend refuses the call, its reason logged; KE_RESULT_OUT_OF_MEMORY.

vtables.name: ke_ecs_commands
vtables.doc: A queue of structural mutations. Every operation records its intent and returns; none changes the world while it runs. The queue is applied, in the order the operations were recorded, by whoever owns it, and an operation's effect is not observable before then. A caller needing a change visible at once uses ke_ecs, which mutates immediately. Recording never touches the world, so these operations may be called while other code reads it. The queue is applied while nothing else runs. An implementation that cannot accept an operation returns its code, logs the reason, and leaves the queue unchanged: KE_RESULT_NOT_SUPPORTED in a phase that may not change structure, KE_RESULT_OUT_OF_MEMORY when the queue cannot grow.

slots.name: spawn
slots.doc: Records the creation of an entity and answers the id it will have. The id can be named by later operations of this queue, and by any caller, at once; the entity itself exists once the queue is applied.

params.name: out_entity
params.doc: Receives the id; KE_ENTITY_INVALID on failure.

slots.name: attach
slots.doc: Records giving `entity` the component `cid`, initialised from `size` bytes of `data`. The bytes are copied, so the caller's buffer need not outlive the call. `size` must equal the registered size of `cid`, or be 0 to attach the component without copying bytes into it.
slots.return_doc: KE_RESULT_INVALID_ARGUMENT, besides the codes above, when `size` is neither 0 nor the registered size of `cid`.

slots.name: detach
slots.doc: Records removing component `cid` from `entity`.

slots.name: despawn
slots.doc: Records destroying `entity`.

slots.name: defer
slots.doc: Records a structural operation for work the fixed verbs above cannot express. `fn` runs when the queue is applied, in order with the other operations. `user_size` bytes of `user` are copied, so the caller's buffer need not outlive the call.
slots.return_doc: KE_RESULT_INVALID_ARGUMENT, besides the codes above, for a null `fn`.

vtables.name: ke_node_ctx
vtables.doc: What a behaviour is given. Behaviours run one at a time, never two at once, so a body may read any node; it changes structure (a node, a component, an event) only through the calls that record into `commands`, applied after the body returns.

fields.name: self
fields.doc: The node next moved to; KE_ENTITY_INVALID before the first call of next.

fields.name: fields
fields.doc: The node's own fields, the struct its type was registered with; NULL for a type without fields.

fields.name: event
fields.doc: The event an on handler is delivering; NULL in every other behaviour.

fields.name: event_type
fields.doc: The type of `event`; KE_COMPONENT_INVALID in every other behaviour.

fields.name: dt
fields.doc: Seconds since the previous tick, or the fixed timestep in fixed_update.

fields.name: commands
fields.doc: The queue structural changes are recorded into.

slots.name: next
slots.doc: Moves to the next node, or the next pair of a node and an event.
slots.return_doc: false when there is none left.

slots.name: get
slots.doc: One of the node's components: its fields or one its type names in `with`.
slots.return_doc: The component's memory for the current node, NULL for a component the type does not carry.

slots.name: component
slots.doc: Any node's component, the current node's or another's.
slots.return_doc: The component's memory on node, NULL for a node that does not carry it.

slots.name: parent
slots.doc: The node's parent, KE_ENTITY_INVALID for a node at the root.

slots.name: child
slots.doc: The child of node named name, KE_ENTITY_INVALID when it has none.

slots.name: first_child
slots.doc: The first child of node, KE_ENTITY_INVALID when it has none.

slots.name: next_sibling
slots.doc: The child after node under the same parent, KE_ENTITY_INVALID after the last.

slots.name: ancestor
slots.doc: The nearest ancestor of node holding component, KE_ENTITY_INVALID when none does.

slots.name: axis
slots.doc: The value of an axis action, 0 without input actions or for a name no map holds.

params.name: action
params.doc: Resolved by name on its first read, and kept resolved.

slots.name: pressed
slots.doc: Whether a button action was pressed this tick, false without input actions or for a name no map holds.

params.name: action
params.doc: Resolved by name on its first read, and kept resolved.

slots.name: spawn
slots.doc: Records a node of type named name under parent, its fields and the components its type names in `with` holding their initial values.
slots.return_doc: KE_OK; KE_RESULT_INVALID_ARGUMENT for a component the type does not carry or one whose size is not its registered size; KE_RESULT_NOT_FOUND for a type never registered, or the queue's code.

params.name: parent
params.doc: KE_ENTITY_INVALID places it at the root.

params.name: components
params.doc: Components the node starts with in place of its type's initial values.

params.name: out_node
params.doc: Usable as a reference at once; the node exists once the commands are applied.

slots.name: destroy
slots.doc: Records the destruction of node and its descendants.
slots.return_doc: KE_OK, or the queue's code.

slots.name: raise
slots.doc: Records data as an event of type event, delivered to the on handlers of the PostUpdate of this tick that run after it is applied, and gone at the next PreUpdate.
slots.return_doc: KE_OK; KE_RESULT_NOT_FOUND for an event never registered, KE_RESULT_INVALID_ARGUMENT for a size that is not the event's, or the queue's code.

params.name: data
params.doc: Copied.

slots.name: exit
slots.doc: Asks the runtime for the program to end; the host stops once it reads the request.

vtables.name: ke_node_types
vtables.doc: Node types and the events between them: each behaviour of a registered type runs as a system of its phase over the nodes of the type, one behaviour at a time. A type named `node`, with no fields and no components, is registered from the start.

slots.name: register_type
slots.doc: Registers a node type and the systems of its behaviours.
slots.return_doc: KE_OK; KE_RESULT_INVALID_ARGUMENT for a null or nameless desc, fields of zero size, `initial` without fields, an initial whose size is not its component's, or events without `on`; KE_RESULT_NOT_FOUND for a `with` name or an event never registered; the ecs's or the runtime's code when it refuses.

params.name: desc
params.doc: Read during the call, `initial` copied; the field table and the names it points at must outlive the node types.

params.name: out_type
params.doc: Receives the id of the type's tag.

slots.name: register_event
slots.doc: Registers an event type.
slots.return_doc: KE_OK; KE_RESULT_INVALID_ARGUMENT for a null or nameless event, or the ecs's code.

params.name: event
params.doc: Its name, size and field table.

params.name: out_event
params.doc: Receives the event's component id.

slots.name: spawn
slots.doc: Records a node of type named name under parent into commands, its fields and the components its type names in `with` holding their initial values. The one way a node is created: a behaviour's ctx->spawn is this call with its own commands.
slots.return_doc: KE_OK; KE_RESULT_INVALID_ARGUMENT for null commands, a component the type does not carry or one whose size is not its registered size; KE_RESULT_NOT_FOUND for a type never registered, or the queue's code.

params.name: commands
params.doc: The queue the node is recorded into.

params.name: parent
params.doc: KE_ENTITY_INVALID places it at the root.

params.name: components
params.doc: Components the node starts with in place of its type's initial values.

params.name: out_node
params.doc: Usable as a reference at once; the node exists once the commands are applied.

slots.name: find_type
slots.doc: The id of the type registered under name.
slots.return_doc: KE_OK; KE_RESULT_INVALID_ARGUMENT for a null name or out_type; KE_RESULT_NOT_FOUND for a name no type was registered under.

params.name: name
params.doc: The name its desc gave, `node` for the base type.

params.name: out_type
params.doc: Receives the id; KE_COMPONENT_INVALID when none has the name.

slots.name: find_component
slots.doc: The id of the component registered under name, an engine component named by its `KE_COMPONENT_NAME_*` constant or one the game registered.
slots.return_doc: KE_OK; KE_RESULT_INVALID_ARGUMENT for a null name or out_component; KE_RESULT_NOT_FOUND for a name no component was registered under.

params.name: out_component
params.doc: Receives the id; KE_COMPONENT_INVALID when none has the name.

slots.name: initial
slots.doc: The bytes a node of type is born with in component.
slots.return_doc: The component's registered size of bytes, valid while the node types live; NULL when the type was never registered or does not carry the component.

slots.name: carries
slots.doc: Whether a node of type carries component: its fields or one its type names in `with`.
slots.return_doc: false for a type never registered.

callbacks.name: ke_defer_fn
callbacks.doc: A structural operation applied when the queue holding it is drained. `user` points at the copy of the payload passed to defer; `ecs` is the live world. A failure is returned, and the queue stops there: the operations recorded after it are dropped.

callbacks.name: ke_node_behaviour_fn
callbacks.doc: One call of a behaviour over the nodes of its type. The body walks them with next, which points self and fields at each node in turn; an on handler walks every pair of a node and an event, with event pointing at the event.

lanes.name: ctx
lanes.doc: What the body works with for the duration of the call.
